lubdhaka: A tall man in an expensive dark coat over a kurta, rings on his fingers, a leather satchel, usually half in shadow; never monstrous.
svarika: A small spirit of cool grey stone in the shape of a young woman holding a lotus, with a fine crack down one cheek and eyes of pale gold.
